zh.title: 研究方向
paragraphs: 我的研究兴趣是构建实用、高效且可扩展的机器学习系统（MLSys）。我主要关注算法与系统的协同设计，以及大语言模型（LLM）与智能体（Agent）系统。

interests.name: 高效 LLM 与 Agent 系统
interests.description: 探索如何提升多智能体系统的并发能力，并高效管理智能体的上下文。

en.title: Research
paragraphs: I am interested in building practical, efficient, and scalable machine learning systems (MLSys). My work focuses on algorithm–system co-design and systems for large language models (LLMs) and agents.

interests.name: Efficient LLM and Agent Systems
interests.description: Exploring how to improve concurrency in multi-agent systems and manage agent context efficiently.
